name: daedalus
description: The daedalus plug-and-play dev workflow and its browser-QA companion.

plugins.name: daedalus
plugins.description: Plug-and-play Plan → Code → Review → QA workflow: detects each project's stacks and commands into .workflow/profile.json, plans per layer, implements with stack packs, tests with safe commands, and reviews with Argus. Browser QA is the daedalus-qa companion.

plugins.name: daedalus-qa
plugins.description: Browser QA companion for daedalus: the qa-tester role, the manual-qa skill and /manual-test, with the Playwright MCP server. Install only for projects with a UI.
